notes.title: New update now released!
notes.notes: A new update is now live for Leave No One Behind. This release includes a range of behind-the-scenes changes and fixes to some of the reported issues. More to come soon. Thank you all for your feedback

notes.title: Patch - 2022/10/24
notes.notes:
Changelog: 
[list]
[*]Added: Checkpoints during missions
[*]Changed: Optimized save file sizes
[*]Fixed: Mission timing tweaks
[*]Fixed: Save system bugfixes
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 2022/3/31
notes.notes:
Changelog: 
[list]
[*]Added: in-game manual
[*]Added: 2x speed function
[*]Changed: clickable tasks have small ribbon in the corner
[*]Changed: other UI tweaks
[*]Changed: slightly increased grenade launcher and rocket launcher fire rates
[*]Fixed: destroying a landed helicopter would result in broken save for the next mission
[*]Fixed: wounded soldiers saving with wrong positions
[*]Fixed: random crash when ending a mission on the map [b]Camp Plei Me[/b]
[*]Fixed: players without access to "My Documents" folder not being able to save game (it will be saved to [i]%userprofile%\appdata\locallow[/i] instead)
[/list]

notes.title: Patch - 2022/3/12
notes.notes:
Changelog: 
[list]
[*]Improved tutorial
[*]Added cheat menu
[*]Fixed edge-cases where missions wouldn't load
[*]Fixed the lost patrol sometimes getting stuck in mission 2
[*]Added lots of analytics so we can find the issues faster when they arise
[/list]

For those who are having troubles getting through the tutorial mission, our scenario writer Andrej wrote and recorded a walkthrough of the whole LZ Falcon mission.

You can find it in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2774963345][b]Guides[/b][/url] section and on our [url=https://youtu.be/O33ri5l8E70][b]YouTube[/b][/url]

[previewyoutube=O33ri5l8E70;full][/previewyoutube]

If you encounter any issues please let us now in the discussions or directly on our e-mail: lnob@studio301.cz

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I woud like to share an update about our game and it's release plan.

We've tried really hard to finish the game this December, but unfortunately we have to delay our release once again. Although the content of the game is finished, there are still some issues that we have to fix before we can release it.

After two years of development, we didn't want to ruin our hard work by rushing the release. Apart from that, rushing for a Decemeber release would put a further strain on our developers, which is not how we want to operate our studio.

We are sorry about this inconvenience and we are looking forward to January 2022 as our new release date.



I hope you all have a wonderful holiday and a happy new year
